header.title: FinPilot AI Finance Copilot
header.description: An interactive, data-grounded financial decision-support assistant powered by Google Gemini. Copilot answers questions using your authoritative financial records, deterministic cash flow projections, and active risk alerts.

chips.title: Suggested Financial Questions:
chips.cashBalance: What is our current cash position and runway?
chips.nextMonth: What will happen to our cash in the next 30 days?
chips.risks: What financial risks require attention right now?
chips.deficit: Why do we have an operating deficit?
chips.financing: What financing options suit our cash flow profile?
chips.receivables: How much cash is trapped in pending invoices?

chat.placeholder: Ask Copilot about your cash balance, burn rate, risks, or financing...
chat.disclaimer: FinPilot Copilot is a read-only decision-support tool. It cannot execute transactions, alter records, or provide certified accounting advice.
